Entries.Coal_Description: Buyum yasash va eritishda foydali yonuvchan tosh.
Entries.CobblestonePath_Description: Yo‘lak yaratish yoki polni chiroyli qilish uchun yerga joylashtiring.
Entries.Coconut_Description: Kokos palmasining urug‘i. Pazandachilikda ko‘p maqsadda ishlatiladi.
Entries.Coffee_Description: Hidi juda mazali. Bu albatta sizga kuch beradi.
Entries.CoffeeBean_Description: Qahva o‘simligi yetishtirish uchun bahor yoki yozda eking. Qahva tayyorlash uchun besh dona donni bochkaga soling.
Entries.CommonMushroom_Description: Biroz yong‘oq ta’mli va tuzilishi yaxshi.
Entries.CompleteBreakfast_Description: Butun dunyoni zabt etishga tayyordek his qilasiz!
Entries.CookoutKit_Description: Yo‘lda ovqat pishirish uchun gulxan yaratishda ishlating!
Entries.CopperOre_Description: Quymaga eritish mumkin bo‘lgan keng tarqalgan ruda.
Entries.CopperStone_Description: Bu tosh ichida mis rudasi bor.
Entries.Coral_Description: Chiroyli tuzilmalar hosil qilish uchun bir joyga to‘planadigan mayda jonzotlar koloniyasi.
Entries.Corn_Description: Eng mashhur donlardan biri. Shirin, yangi so‘tasi yozda juda seviladi.
Entries.CornSeeds_Description: Yoz yoki kuzda eking. 14 kunda yetiladi va birinchi hosildan keyin ham hosil berishda davom etadi.
Entries.Crab_Description: Ikkita kuchli changakli dengiz qisqichbaqasimon jonzoti.
Entries.CrabCakes_Description: Qisqichbaqa go‘shti, non uvog‘i va tuxumdan kotlet yasab, tillarang bo‘lguncha qovurilgan.
Entries.CrabPot_Description: Suvga joylashtiring, ichiga yem soling va ertasi kuni biror narsa tutganingizni tekshiring. Oqim suvlar, ko‘llar va okeanda ishlaydi.
Entries.CrabshellRing_Description: Uzukning tepasi sehrlangan qisqichbaqa qobig‘idan yasalgan.
Entries.Cranberries_Description: Bu nordon qizil rezavorlar an’anaviy qishki taomdir.
Entries.CranberryCandy_Description: Achchiq meva ta’mini yashirish uchun yetarlicha shirin.
